slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about contract start months and consecutive coverage, but did not ask whether a signed contract must remain active for its entire coverage period or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether at least two different contract lengths must be used, or whether a single contract duration alone is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any cap on the number of distinct contract lengths or contract types that may be signed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state; the P0 objective and exact-demand slots were clarified, but the P1 contract-length diversity slot remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified the objective and exact monthly demand, but failed to ask about contract-length diversity, maximum distinct contracts, or full-period contract commitment, and the interaction ended without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
